acceptance.criterion_verbatim: every never-sum rule is stated with its reason (cross-master, cross-firm, cross-date, non-additive field)
acceptance.output_evidence:
[2026-09-21T06:13:28Z] AC4 -- every never-sum rule with its reason (cross-master/cross-firm/cross-date/non-additive field)
  1. AUA (market value) is never derived by summing transaction flows across a date range
     REASON: non-additive field / wrong basis -- README.md:10-27 states flow-based AUA omits market gains/losses; use allocations.account_market_value at a single as_of_date instead
  2. allocations.account_market_value (or unrealized.market_value) is never summed across more than one as_of_date
     REASON: cross-date -- each partition is a point-in-time snapshot; summing snapshots from different dates conflates distinct points in time
  3. realized gain/loss and unrealized gain/loss are never summed into one figure without labeling which is which
     REASON: non-additive field -- different measurement basis (realized = already-closed positions; unrealized = still-open mark-to-market, README.md:1103-1107)
  4. transactions.market_value is never summed across silver/transactions/ daily partitions without first deduping by transaction_id
     REASON: cross-date -- BD re-sends prior transaction_ids in later exports (merge-daily-incremental.py:474-507 cross-date dedup logic; a 30-day lookback dedup exists precisely because this happens)
  5. canonical_prices/historical_prices/interpolated_prices.price (or .close) is never summed across asset_id/ticker/asset_name
     REASON: non-additive field -- a price is a per-unit value, not a quantity; summing prices of different securities has no meaning without units held
  6. Black Diamond (49financial, data/black_diamond/) figures are never summed with Cottonwood's separately-tracked Black-Diamond-flavored data (data/cot/)
     REASON: cross-firm -- scopes.json marks the two pipeline_trees separated_from each other
  7. fees.transaction_fee/account_fee/flat_fee is never summed across billing periods without checking billing_start_date/billing_end_date for overlap
     REASON: cross-date -- adjacent billing periods can overlap or re-bill; the schema carries explicit start/end date columns for this reason (convert_fees_to_silver.py:41)
VERDICT: PASS-MXA3-AC4
acceptance.denominator: 7 of 7 never-sum rules carry a reason drawn from one of the four named classes (cross-master/cross-firm/cross-date/non-additive field); 0 cross-master rules apply (single-master property, see AC3).
